head.title: Fly Pet on your phone
head.lede: Chat with your fly, and get a notification when it trades, when money moves, when it replies, and for alpha calls.

install.title: Add it to your home screen
install.ios1: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow).
install.ios3: Open Fly Pet from your home screen and come back to step 2.
install.iosWhy: On iPhone, notifications only work from the home screen app.
install.inapp: You're in a wallet's browser, which can't install apps. Open this page in Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android).
install.android: Tap Install, or in Chrome's menu (⋮) tap "Install app" / "Add to Home screen".
install.desktop: Open this page on your phone: flyaiworld.com/pet-mobile. On a computer, get the desktop Fly Pet instead.

sign.title: Sign in with your wallet
sign.out: The same sign-in as the website. Your fly's money never moves from here.

push.title: Turn on notifications
push.nosupport: This browser can't get notifications. On iPhone, open Fly Pet from your home screen (step 1).
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your phone's settings, then come back.

kind.tradesHint: Your fly bought or sold something
kind.alphaHint: The same calls as our Discord (a few a day)

msg.sent: Sent. It should show in a few seconds.
msg.off: Notifications are off on this phone.
msg.serverOff: Notifications aren't switched on yet. Check back soon.

chat.title: Chat with your fly
chat.p: Ask what it's doing, why it traded, or tell it what to change. It only suggests: nothing changes until you approve.

alpha.title: Latest alpha calls
alpha.note: Calls, not advice: always check the token yourself.
